note: Revision data, not code. The generator reads this file; it decides nothing itself. A module is listed under 'frozen_modules' only after its contract packet passed a human review gate, and the reviewer is named alongside the date. Adding a module here is the freeze; removing one un-freezes it and the drift guard will report every hash that moves.

M00.note: Placeholder contract generated from real M00 code and frozen so drift is detectable.

M02.note: Academic registry packet, OpenAPI, DTO/event schemas, error rows and consumer fixtures reviewed and approved. Shared compatibility items in contracts/M02/review-decisions.md approved with them.

unfrozen_note: M01 access is implemented and merged to main, but no tracked record shows its packet passing the review gate, so it stays 'not_started' here. Its artefacts are still hashed, so drift is reported; they are simply not claimed as approved. Freezing M01 is a separate reviewed decision and must not be done as a side effect of another module's freeze.
